protocol.gallery: all other cached segments in the query's intersection cluster
protocol.relevance: same intersection cluster and same maneuver label
protocol.metric: full conditional-gallery AP, macro-averaged over eligible queries
protocol.eligibility: at least one relevant and one non-relevant gallery candidate
protocol.query_set: exactly the global retrieval eligible-query set (fail-closed)
protocol.query_identity: query_index is the score-cache row; segment_index is that row's dense_to_segment value
protocol.uncertainty: intersection-cluster bootstrap over fixed per-query AP
